title: The edit window for a Part Library entry is titled Edit Library Part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: 1 Part Library entry [PN-A] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EDITTITLE-01).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [PN-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL edit title" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EDITTITLE-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Check the setup worked: Parts → Part Library, Search [PN-A] lists 1 entry.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type [PN-A] in the Search box.
  3. Click the [PN-A] row.
  4. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Read the dialog title.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The dialog is titled "Edit Library Part" (not "Edit Catalog Part").
  • Step 6: The dialog closes without changes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
